stage1.impression: A clean, well-exposed high-key packshot: the red horn glows convincingly and the left edge is crisply traced, but the cabinet reads as a dull brick-red and milky-pink box rather than stained glass, and it sits on the seamless with only a thin pencil-line shadow, so it half-floats. Competent product visualization that still reads as CG: flat sheen on the side panel, the busy interior seen through the clear, and no coloured light thrown onto the floor.

blocking_9: Cabinet front glows with transmitted light (front panel r_median > 180, lum_median 95-130) instead of reading as dark brick red (lum 63, r 138)
Right side panel saturated and traced by a black edge, not a flat milky pink wash (g_median 136, range 11.6)
A grounded soft contact shadow that carries weight, falling off over ~40-60 px, not ~15 px
Some coloured light or tint from the acrylic on the seamless at the base
Neutral-to-warm white seamless matching the specified #F3F1EE (now cool, b-r = +6, dE 3.6)

defects.what: Cabinet front reads dark, opaque brick red (lum ~63-70, rgb ~138/46/44); little light passes through, no stained-glass glow
Right side panel is a flat, desaturated milky pink (rgb 194/136/137, lum range 11.6): it mirrors the white sweep behind-right; its outer vertical edge is soft (14 px 10-90) versus 1 px on the left
Contact shadow is a thin dark line that clears to floor white within ~15 px; the product barely weighs on the seamless
Horn throat / compression driver is a crushed black blob (34% of pixels crushed), no shape read
Seamless renders cool blue-white (244/248/250) against a warm specified #F3F1EE (dE2000 3.6) and warm lamps
Interior parts (ports, crossover box, braces) clutter the clear lower cabinet
No red light cast onto the floor (no caustics), so the colour does not touch the set

changes.problem: The cabinet front does not glow: too little light comes through it from behind, so it reads as opaque brick rather than tinted glass.

change.to: bg-right target [-0.9,4.0,0.8] (the sweep patch on the camera's line through the cabinet) at 2.8 W/m2; back-top 5.0

changes.expected: Cabinet front lifts to a luminous saturated red, interior parts silhouette darker against it, background stays below clipping.

changes.problem: The right side panel mirrors the bright sweep behind-right and washes to milky pink; flag 2 sits off the reflected ray so the right vertical edge has no black line.

evidence.measured: rgb 194/136/137, lum range 11.6; right edge width 14 px vs left 1 px

changes.expected: Right side darkens to a saturated red with a black reflected band at its rear edge; edge 10-90 width <= 4 px.

changes.problem: The contact shadow is too tight and too light, so the speaker floats.

evidence.measured: floor recovers to lum 244.7 within ~15 px below the base (profile 38 -> 230 -> 245)

changes.expected: A soft grey pool spreading 40-60 px around the base, darkest at the footprint.

changes.problem: The seamless is cool blue-white while the set colour and every lamp are warm.

change.to: tint 0.0, 5000 K (adjust until the sweep is neutral-warm)

changes.expected: Seamless reads as warm paper white; red shifts slightly warmer and truer.

changes.problem: The compression driver inside the horn crushes to a black blob with no form.

change.to: azimuth 175, elevation 38 (shines down the horn's mouth from behind-above, lighting the driver's rim)

changes.expected: A rim on the driver body and the horn walls around it; crushed pixels under 15%.

changes.problem: Without caustics the acrylic throws no colour onto the seamless, so the product does not touch its set.

evidence.measured: rgb 243/245/249 just in front of the base: no red at all

change.to: 0.6 x 0.3 m area at [0.1, 0.3, 0.02] facing -y along the floor, colour sampled from the product's tint (per colourway), irradiance 0.4, camera false, specular 0

changes.expected: A faint red bloom on the floor just in front of and behind the base, r_median exceeding g_median by 8-20.

changes.problem: At 0.98 m the camera looks slightly down on a 1.29 m object, which shrinks its presence for a hero.

evidence.measured: top of cabinet seen; product spans 72% of frame height

changes.expected: More monumental, top of cabinet nearly edge-on, horn reads against the white.

out_of_scope.request: Hide or simplify the interior parts (ports, crossover box, braces) visible through the clear lower cabinet
out_of_scope.why: They are parts of the speaker; changing them changes the product
